m1.typescript: m1 a compliant deployment has no findings

e1.typescript: e1 residency is pinned by the request or by the region the platform allows

e2.typescript: e2 zero data retention is an arrangement of the providers own platforms and not of every model

e3.typescript: e3 protected health information needs a covered platform an agreement and deidentified input

e4.typescript: e4 a multi tenant service needs a workspace for each tenant

e5.typescript: e5 an audit log must not store prompts that hold sensitive data

e6.typescript: e6 audit retention stays between the minimum and the maximum

e7.typescript: e7 purge only what is past the retention limit and not on hold

e8.typescript: e8 a request is served only by a deployment that keeps its data in the region

wrong-geo-unset-passes.defect: treats a request with no inference geo as pinned to the US

wrong-eu-pin-allowed.defect: accepts a European residency requirement on the first-party API

wrong-any-region-for-us.defect: accepts any cloud region for a US residency requirement

wrong-cloud-zdr-ok.defect: treats the zero data retention flag as valid on a cloud provider's platform

wrong-fable-zdr-ok.defect: ignores that the top-tier model needs 30-day retention

wrong-baa-optional.defect: does not ask for a signed agreement for protected health information on the API

wrong-aws-hipaa-ok.defect: accepts protected health information on a platform without HIPAA readiness

wrong-redact-not-safe.defect: accepts only tokenising and rejects redaction as de-identification

wrong-tenancy-ignored.defect: does not check the isolation of tenants

wrong-audit-phi-only.defect: flags stored prompts only when health data is in scope and not for other identifiers

wrong-retention-long-inclusive.defect: flags a retention equal to the maximum as too long

wrong-retention-short-inclusive.defect: flags a retention equal to the minimum as too short

wrong-purge-held.defect: purges an entry that is on legal hold

wrong-purge-boundary.defect: purges an entry that is exactly at the limit

wrong-global-fallback.defect: serves a request from a global deployment when the regional one is missing

wrong-pick-first-listed.defect: picks the first listed deployment and not the first by name
